name: salesforce-inspector-enhanced
description: A modern, themeable browser extension for inspecting and editing Salesforce records, running SOQL and monitoring org limits.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../salesforce-inspector-enhanced-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -qrX ../salesforce-inspector-enhanced-$npm_package_version.zip .
